$comment: The models Guard offers in its model picker. Model ids change over time: edit this file to add or rename one. Any id that matches ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:-]{0,79}$ can also be typed in by hand. backends: anthropic-api (your own API key) and claude-cli (your Claude plan through Claude Code).

models.label: Claude Sonnet 5.5
models.note: Balanced speed, quality and cost. The default.

models.label: Claude Opus 5.5
models.note: Most capable. Slower and costs more.

models.label: Claude Haiku 5.5
models.note: Fastest and cheapest. Good for short, simple jobs.

models.label: Claude Fable 5.2
models.note: Another Anthropic model line. Use it if your key can access it.

models.label: Sonnet (plan)
models.note: Balanced. The default for the Claude plan.

models.label: Opus (plan)
models.note: Most capable. Slower, and uses more of your plan allowance.

models.label: Haiku (plan)
models.note: Fastest, and uses the least of your plan allowance.
